title: Venture Quest Kayak

services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: We rent single and double kayaks and stand up paddleboards from our dock on the Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf. The kayak office is the first one on the left across from Lifeguard Headquarters. You can drive out onto the wharf and park near the kayaks. To get info about kayak rentals call the kayak office at 831 425 8445.
